design.name: 沙祀
design.brief: The bandit faction's Nuo ritual priest (傩师): a tall gaunt figure wearing a carved red-and-gold lacquered three-eyed Nuo opera mask (傩面) with glowing ember-orange eyes and fierce painted brows, a tall black Taoist-style ritual crown with gold flames, a large round bronze mirror (铜镜) with eight-trigram (八卦) markings and a flame-shaped rim mounted behind the head like a halo, long layered ritual robes of sand white, black and crimson with gold cloud-scroll and meander embroidery, the faction's crimson sash, strings of bronze bells and dangling yellow paper talismans (符箓) with red brush strokes, wide sleeves pushed up, bare dark-tan forearms with glowing ember-orange Taoist talisman tattoo lines. Long thin hands with a clearly separate thumb and four long separate fingers. Straw sandals with five visible toes on each foot.
design.weapon: a tall Buddhist-Taoist nine-ring staff (九环锡杖) with a bronze flame finial holding an ember-orange fire and a long red soul-summoning banner (招魂幡)
